value.label: SYNTHETIC quiz demonstration; delivery ledger is supplemental evidence, not an API response

parameters.content:
## Quiz progress demonstration

Manual only. Demo inputs are synthetic and include separate delivery evidence and student attempts. Rules and thresholds come from student-tracker/config.yaml; regenerate this export after changing them.

Attach a credential for a disposable DEMO Postgres database with the student-tracker schema. No Alcovia API is called. Unknown evidence is reported. Delivery and attempts are stored atomically; database errors fail the manual run visibly. Demo summary shows rejected rows. This does not update live pipeline freshness.
